script_text: Stop, Pisces—Mars is knocking on a door you’ve avoided, and it will not wait politely. Mars in Virgo opposes Pisces across your 1st-to-7th House axis, while the Sun in Libra opposes your 1st House, intensifying confrontations. Saturn remains conjunct Pisces in your 1st House, and Jupiter, ruler of your water-element Pisces, moves through Scorpio in your 9th House, turning tension into strategy. In love, a spark may come through coworkers or practical acquaintances, but Mars demands honesty; if partnered, watch for irritation disguised as a rational critique. Avoid familiar intensity. Career and money improve through 9th-House Jupiter: request the promotion, cross-border role, or advanced training you have earned. Saturn in the 1st House says to budget deliberately and stop overpromising your time. Your unexpected gift is one brutally clear conversation that saves you from a mismatched path. Follow for tomorrow’s reading.
